topic: Skit: ten coins — on 12 Jan 2009 (block 170) Satoshi Nakamoto sent Hal Finney 10 BTC as a test, the first bitcoin transfer; Hal reported bugs, Satoshi fixed them; Hal switched mining off because of the heat and fan noise, later wishing he'd kept it up and calling himself extraordinarily lucky to be there (buddy-film, never-meet)
